      Record a change

      Only the rota maker sees this. Publishing updates the roster for everyone who opens the page and adds the change to the log below.

      This roster has not been marked as checked. When you have gone through it, record that here: the live page then says who checked it, and the block changeover goes ahead without a warning.

      How changes work

      • This page is the roster. A change counts only once it appears here, and attendance follows the page.
      • Swaps are like for like and agreed by both doctors. Resus in-charge and supervisor slots go only to someone qualified for that role.
      • Ask at least 48 hours ahead, except in an emergency. Requests go to the rota maker, who approves and publishes.
      • Residents' swaps also go through the programme, as duty hours must be checked.

      A change to this block: use "Request a change" at the top of this tab. Leave, courses, days off and preferences for a coming block: choose "Request for a coming block" there before that block's roster is made (the rota makers see it with the block's requests).
